name: witr
summary: Answers “why is this running?” by tracing a process, port, container or file back to what started it
description: witr takes a process name, PID, port, container or file and walks the chain that caused it to run: the systemd unit, shell, cron job, container runtime or parent process behind it. It prints a readable explanation, machine-readable JSON for scripts, or an interactive TUI for digging through the tree. Handy when a port is busy or a stray process appears and you want the cause, not just the symptom.
